personal.title: Software Developer & Open Source Contributor
personal.description:
I love turning ideas into working software. I'm a Computer Science student, software developer and open-source contributor exploring the intersection of full-stack development, AI and technology.

From building applications to contributing to open-source communities, I'm always looking for opportunities to learn, experiment and create something meaningful.
highlights: GirlScript Summer of Code 2026 Contributor & Ambassador

about.heading: More than just writing code.
paragraphs: Hey! I'm Sagar Gupta, a Computer Science student at PW Institute of Innovation, Bangalore.
I'm passionate about building software, understanding how technology works behind the scenes and turning interesting ideas into useful digital products.

My journey into development started with curiosity about how websites and applications work. That curiosity gradually grew into an interest in backend engineering, full-stack development, AI-powered applications and open-source software.

I enjoy learning by building. Whether it's designing APIs, working with databases, experimenting with AI or exploring new technologies, I like understanding the complete picture rather than just writing code that works.
Beyond development, I've explored the open-source ecosystem and student technology communities through GirlScript Summer of Code and Google Summer of Code.
I'm still learning, experimenting and figuring things out — and that's what makes this journey exciting.
highlights: Interested in software engineering, backend development and AI
Always curious about new technologies and ideas
